# HAIEC Site: Suggestions-Only Decision Brief for Owners and Future Devin Work
**Date:** 2026-10-21. **Strict instruction:** Review and recommend ONLY. Do not edit, create branches, push, commit, open a PR, merge, change policy/billing, or deploy in subodhkc/haiec-website. Common Repo documents are the only approved mutable artifacts.
**Controlling audit:** HAIEC-READONLY-PRODUCTION-61-ROUTE-SITE-AUDIT-LEGAL-AND-VALUE-RECOMMENDATIONS-2026-10-21.md. Production Vercel READY deploy dpl_3EtwkaZQv4SUy4xBfKD2FG75Fn3E, Main SHA 677de7a703b36e1b1abdd1cc125ef05509d133cd, PR #2321. No interactive browser QA in that audit.

## Executive recommendation
Do NOT lengthen already substantial Manufacturing, Telecom, Homepage, Platform or Enterprise pages based on stale crawls. The shipped #2320 interactive modules and new #2321 footer have corrected the earlier content and discovery issues. The actual weak point for enterprise trust is now **inconsistent unsupported legal, pricing and safety promises in legacy regulated-industry pages linked from modern Solutions**. Give owners a concrete decision and source-backed proposed replacement, then separately do a real browser acceptance journey.

## P0 decisions (recommendations, no changes authorized)
1. **Industry Overview:** Recommend REMOVE from modern Solutions navigation until factual claims are owner approved if quick remediation is not possible. If owner chooses KEEP, remove 100% automated evidence, 10x compliance, guaranteed auditor acceptance, HIPAA-compliant AI and unsupported regulation count unless evidence supplied. Rebuild around eligible source, concern, mapped framework question, evidence limit, human assessor and next bounded POC. Keep existing useful industry use cases. Decision owner Product + marketing + counsel + SEO. SEO decisions follow backlinks/traffic, not convenience.
2. **Finance child:** Recommend do not claim HAIEC currently automates legally sufficient FCRA adverse-action notices, SHAP/LIME explainability or fair lending testing unless the exact UI/API/engine, current feature flags, test artifacts and qualified counsel support those exact claims. Never imply HAIEC certification. Qualify financial fines/case studies with dated named source or remove figures. Owner Product/finance-regulatory counsel.
3. **Healthcare child:** Recommend withdraw "HIPAA-compliant AI", guaranteed audit passes, $49/month medical product and handling-of-PHI assumptions unless exact contracted product scope/Budget/Pricing/BAA/privacy and third-party review support them. Better safe educational copy: "Assess supported technical evidence relevant to selected healthcare privacy and security controls. HIPAA applicability and compliance are determined by the covered entity and its qualified advisers." Owner security/privacy counsel + product + pricing.
4. **SaaS child:** Recommend remove 70%/80% time or cost savings, ROI and $490/month legacy pricing unless exact current offer and dated performance baseline; link canonical /pricing or /enterprise. Promote bounded technical assurance outcomes, not instant SOC2 certification. Owner product/finance/legal.
5. **HR child broken:** `/small-business-ai-compliance/hr-recruiting` is absent in deployed source and public URL reports 404. Link to approved current /solutions/nyc-ll144-compliance only if its law scope matches and legal owner approves; otherwise remove its CTA until a suitable route exists. Owner site nav/regulatory counsel/SEO.

## P0/P1 legal and privacy questions, with recommendations
| Decision owner | Evidence still needed | Recommended public statement until cleared |
|---|---|---|
| Privacy/counsel and data engineering | Production retention jobs, database model mapping, preservation/legal hold exceptions, tenant deletion behavior, backup window vs 2555/730/90-day policy constants and scan-history visibility | "HAIEC applies record-class retention policies subject to contractual terms, legal holds and available deletion controls." Exact durations only where the running system and legal promise align. |
| Security/procurement | Vendor SOC2 reports and scopes for Vercel/Neon/Modal/Resend/GitHub/Sentry/Upstash, periods and HAIEC's own status | "We use third-party infrastructure providers with published assurance programs. Provider attestations apply to their services, not a certification of HAIEC." No broad end-to-end certification claim until verified. |
| Privacy/frontend | RB2B first-party cookie activation/consent jurisdiction, notice, opt-outs, privacy requests, cookie classification and retention | Disclose actual visitor company identification, consent/opt-out mechanisms and data-sharing boundary as applicable; do not rely on a policy page alone as legal operational proof. |
| Product/security | Source transient processing vs optional uploads/evidence vault, scanner findings vs raw snippets, authorized telemetry, downstream retention, open-source standalone packages | "Source analysis and other connected evidence flows have different data-handling needs; each supported integration is governed by its configured permissions and retention." Avoid absolute no customer sensitive content. |
| Commercial/product | 76-row real UI/API/MCP activity inventory, plan feature switches, Monitor/Protect customer-side installation, configured versus operating, free readiness questionnaire vs paid POC | Present plan rights as Included Software / Requires Configuration / Requires Customer Integration / Requires Enterprise Scoping. A paid tier is not proof production enforcement is running. |
| MARPP owner/counsel | One canonical acronym/spec, named protected fields/tables, actual applied migrations, DB privileged role exceptions, relationship to Assurance Receipt and file digests | Call it "MARPP evidence package" until nomenclature approved. "Supports hash-bound records and applicable database controls where configured; integrity does not prove source truth or certification." |
| Regulatory subject experts | Current NYC LL144, EU AI Act and Colorado legal effective dates, HIPAA/ECOA applicability and exact product testing | "HAIEC can provide supported technical evidence and mappings for specified control questions. Independent legal compliance and certifications remain with responsible parties." |

**Legal disclaimers are not enough when a product claim is false or unverified. Prioritize removing the claim.** Legal and security source owners should approve revised wording before website changes.

## P1 product developer accuracy
Apply existing Page #25/#27/#28/#29 plans, NOT a fresh redesign:
- AI AppSec: npm 0.1.x distinction, Semgrep external dependency, correct stdio MCP and documented CLI; distinguish local source check from HAIEC SaaS.
- MCP Tenant Isolation: distinguish Trusted Publishing vs per-scan hash receipt, 3 default read-only MCP tools and gated write, current --path CLI, Action validity and unsupported competitor absolutes.
- LLMVerify: known injection-risk patterns not guaranteed blocking, PII regex scope, result notChecked and audit persistence, local network/HTTP protection. Fix generic developer AI IDE template without cross-product regression.
- Developer Security three standalone MIT packages remain peers, not a required Source-Boundary-Runtime pipeline.
Owner technical product + open-source package maintainers. Website change requires new approval.

## Acceptance and project governance
This decision brief provides suggested customer copy and questions, **not legal advice or approval**, and no work to HAIEC production. Next future implementer should not modify anything until the user explicitly changes the read-only restriction. On any later authorized change, refresh actual Vercel production SHA, inspect deployed source, choose bounded changes, run targeted checks and report actual changed files/tests; DO NOT treat current Common Repo commit as approval to change HAIEC.
